title: Lily's Adjustment
content: Lily has been showing signs of missing her previous foster family and her brother Alex. She is quiet during group activities and often looks out the window. We are monitoring her closely and providing additional support during this transition period.

title: Lily's Participation in Art Project
content: Lily participated in a group art project last week. She was hesitant at first but eventually drew a picture of a house with a big tree next to it. She didn't share much about her drawing, but it seems to reflect a longing for stability and family.

title: Rosewood Foster Home Update
content: Lily has been moved to the Rosewood Foster Home. The environment is warm and the caregivers are attentive. However, Lily is still adjusting and has not yet fully settled in.

title: Creative Hearts Program
content: Lily was enrolled in the Creative Hearts Program to help her express her emotions and connect with other children. She has attended two sessions so far and seems to be slowly opening up.
